ops.title: homebrew-tap sign-notarize actions wrote dist/-prefixed sha256 manifests — broke captain-hook helper-cask verify beside the downloaded asset; fixed to basename manifests (tap a023f58+0b8cc21, capt-hook pin a3265e47); released manifests are repairable in
ops.body:
2026-07-21. captain-hook's new `helper-cask` release job (added `1376be79`) downloads the released `.zip` + `.zip.sha256` and runs `shasum -a 256 -c` beside them — but `sign-notarize-app` generated the manifest as `shasum -a 256 dist/x.zip > dist/x.zip.sha256`, embedding `dist/` in the path field. Maiden runs on v12.6.0 and v12.7.0 both failed with `shasum: dist/…zip: No such file or directory`; every other release job (publish, plugin sync, GitHub release, helper) was green, so PyPI was live while the run showed red.

**Fix at the primitive** (both actions + the bun lane wrote the same manifest): `(cd dist && shasum -a 256 "${zip##*/}" > "${zip##*/}.sha256")` — tap commit `a023f58`; `0b8cc21` pairs `release-app.yml` (internal action pin bump + its own pre-publish `-c` now runs from `dist/`); captain-hook `a3265e47` bumps the `release-app.yml@` pin. `release-bun`/`release-swift` pin `sign-notarize-binary` via **moving refs** `@bun-v1`/`@swift-v1` owned by those lanes' release contracts — the generation fix rides when those refs next move; don't move them from here.

**Repairing an already-published release**: the manifest's hash field is correct, only the path is wrong — download the `.sha256`, rewrite to `<hash>  <basename>`, `gh release upload --clobber`, then `gh run rerun <id> --failed`; the rerun's snapshot verify (`cd dist/released && shasum -c`) passes against the repaired asset. Only rerun the NEWEST failed release — an older cask version re-publish trips the tap's version guard.

Gotchas: rebasing a stack where a later commit pins an earlier commit's sha re-shas the pin target — re-stamp the pin after `git pull --rebase` before pushing. `gh` can 403 "API rate limit exceeded" from a burst/secondary limit while `gh api rate_limit` (uncounted) shows thousands remaining — check before backing off for an hour. Related: [[nlp-api-surface-wave-shipped]].
